Using the determinant formula, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}a\times b & =|\begin{aligned}i & j & k \\ 1 & 5 & 4 \\ 2 & 3 & 0\end{aligned}| \\  & =|\begin{aligned}5 & 4 \\ 3 & 0\end{aligned}|i-|\begin{aligned}1 & 4 \\ 2 & 0\end{aligned}|j+|\begin{aligned}1 & 5 \\ 2 & 3\end{aligned}|k \\  & =((5)(0)-(3)(4))i-((1)(0)-(2)(4))j+((1)(3)-(2)(5))k \\  & =(0-12)i-(0-8)j+(3-10)k \\  & =-12i+8j-7k.\end{aligned}
$$
